# Semantic Scholar

> Semantic Scholar is an AI-powered academic search engine and research platform providing access to scholarly papers, citations, and an open API for academic graph data.

Semantic Scholar, developed by the Allen Institute for AI, offers researchers, librarians, and developers tools for discovering, organizing, and analyzing academic literature. The platform combines machine learning with comprehensive citation data to help users navigate the scholarly landscape more effectively.

## Key Topics

- Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API
- REST API

- Paper discovery
